comment: Chapter 1, Bunyi Pertama (GDD missions 1.1–1.4). Bayu calls his grandfather Atuk and his mother Mak. Barks never block control; the journal line (j.*) is Tok Wan's handwriting in the hikayat. BM is the source; EN is a natural translation.

k.maksom.call.speaker: maksom
k.maksom.call.bm: Bayu! Dah nak senja ni. Turun ke jeti, tolong mak kemas gerai!
k.maksom.call.en: Bayu! It's nearly dusk. Come down to the jetty and help me pack up the stall!

k.adi.dare.speaker: adi
k.adi.dare.bm: Oi, Bayu! Lumba sampai gerai mak kau. Kalah, belanja air tebu!
k.adi.dare.en: Oi, Bayu! Race you to your mum's stall. Loser buys the sugarcane juice!

k.adi.win.speaker: adi
k.adi.win.bm: Ha! Air tebu, kau yang belanja!
k.adi.win.en: Ha! Sugarcane juice is on you!

k.adi.lose.speaker: adi
k.adi.lose.bm: Tak aci! Kau potong ikut bumbung!
k.adi.lose.en: Not fair! You cut across the roofs!

k.maksom.finish.speaker: maksom
k.maksom.finish.bm: Berlumba lagi? Hati-hati, papan jeti tu dah reput.
k.maksom.finish.en: Racing again? Careful, those jetty planks are rotten.

k.maksom.pondok.speaker: maksom
k.maksom.pondok.bm: Bayu... pergilah ke pondok atuk di hujung jeti. Barang-barang dia masih di situ. Mak belum sanggup.
k.maksom.pondok.en: Bayu... go to Atuk's hut at the end of the jetty. His things are still there. I can't, not yet.

k.bayu.pondok.speaker: bayu
k.bayu.pondok.bm: Pondok atuk... sunyi betul tanpa dia.
k.bayu.pondok.en: Atuk's hut... so quiet without him.

k.bayu.hikayat.speaker: bayu
k.bayu.hikayat.en: Atuk's hikayat. Why is it... glowing?

k.bayu.kelip.speaker: bayu
k.bayu.kelip.en: A firefly? Out of Atuk's book?

k.bayu.call.speaker: bayu
k.bayu.call.en: You want to show me something?

k.adi.display.speaker: adi
k.adi.display.bm: Bayu! Tengok berembang tu, semua menyala!
k.adi.display.en: Bayu! Look at the berembang, they're all lit up!

k.bayu.display.speaker: bayu
k.bayu.display.bm: Atuk selalu bawa aku tengok ni...
k.bayu.display.en: Atuk always brought me here to watch this...

k.adi.dark.speaker: adi
k.adi.dark.en: Hey... why are they going out?

k.bayu.track.speaker: bayu
k.bayu.track.bm: Kesan dakwat... Adi lari ikut bumbung.
k.bayu.track.en: Ink stains... Adi went over the rooftops.

k.bayu.oldJetty.speaker: bayu
k.bayu.oldJetty.bm: Jeti lama. Atuk tak pernah benarkan aku datang sini.
k.bayu.oldJetty.en: The old jetty. Atuk never let me come here.

k.adi.cursed.speaker: adi
k.adi.cursed.bm: Selalu kau... selalu kau yang menang!

k.adi.freed.speaker: adi
k.adi.freed.bm: Bayu? Aku... apa aku dah buat?
k.adi.freed.en: Bayu? What... what did I do?

k.bayu.tree.speaker: bayu
k.bayu.tree.bm: Pelita Air... di puncak berembang paling tinggi.
k.bayu.tree.en: The Pelita Air... at the top of the tallest berembang.

k.bayu.tide.speaker: bayu
k.bayu.tide.bm: Air pasang naik... jangan jatuh, Bayu.
k.bayu.tide.en: The tide's coming in... don't fall, Bayu.

k.adi.thanks.speaker: adi
k.adi.thanks.bm: Gelap tu... macam suara orang berbisik. Terima kasih, Bayu.
k.adi.thanks.en: That darkness... it was like people whispering. Thank you, Bayu.

k.bayu.ebb.speaker: bayu
k.bayu.ebb.bm: Air dah surut. Berembang tu... sekarang.
k.bayu.ebb.en: The tide's going out. The berembang... now.

j.tokwan.1.speaker: tokwan
j.tokwan.1.bm: Cerita yang benar mesti dibacakan, walaupun suara kita bergetar.
j.tokwan.1.en: A true story must be read aloud, even if your voice shakes.
